name: SkyPulse Arcade
subtitle: Flight, Relays & Hacking
promotionalText: Fly the Endless Route, restore Pulse Relay circuits and solve Blackout Protocol puzzles. Complete four daily tasks for five crystals each, up to 20 per UTC day.
description:
Created by Mcaulee Maddison, SkyPulse Arcade brings three ways to play to one offline adventure with mechanical birds, glowing circuits and a collection you build through play.

ENDLESS ROUTE
Tap to flap, thread the gates and collect crystals as you chase your personal best. The route moves through twelve environments, changing every 15 gates before the journey repeats.

PULSE RELAY
Take flight through an orbital station filled with illuminated relay portals. Collect gold Pulse-charge cells, line up with numbered relay windows and use the Pulse control to open each shutter in order. Reach the exit to earn a medal, with optional cells offering a more demanding flight line. Start with First Circuit, then take on Switchback, Highwire and Crossfeed.

BLACKOUT PROTOCOL
Trade reflexes for planning on an emerald circuit board. Move between adjacent nodes, recover the required data packets and reach the exit before your trace budget runs out. Limited hack charges open firewalls, but raise your trace by three. Every move adds one trace, so choose your route carefully. Solve Packet Recovery, Firewall Fork, Quiet Bypass and Dark Weave, each with its own completion medal.

DAILY MISSION CONTROL
Work towards four daily tasks across your attempts. Claim five crystals for each completed task, up to 20 daily-task crystals per day. Tasks need no account or purchase, and the daily reset time is shown in your local time zone.

BUILD YOUR COLLECTION
Earn crystals to unlock 15 cosmetic birds, all with the same flight handling. Explore nine Tech Tree nodes with three levels each to improve the Endless Route collection and reward effects shown in the game. Mission medals and your Endless best are saved separately.

THREE MODES, THREE ATMOSPHERES
Home opens on Endless Route. Tap the top-left mode badge to reveal the three free modes, choose one and press Play. Each mode has its own scenery, lighting and animated Home screen, from the Endless skyline to orbital relay hardware and the Blackout data-core chamber.

Designed for portrait play on iPhone and iPad, with Reduced Motion and haptic controls. Play offline with no advertising, account or real-money purchases. Your scores, crystals, collection, upgrades, medals, daily progress and preferences are saved on your device.
